note: Alpha Bank's Bonus Visa: 17.75% a year on purchases, to which the 0.60% levy of Law 128/75 is added, written as their sum, 18.35%; and 30 euros a year for the main card. The first year free is introductory, and the lower rate and waived fee for a salary or pension paid into Alpha Bank aren't written, the game not tracking where pay is deposited. On 2026-10-30 the range was widened to the main banks: National Bank of Greece, Piraeus Bank, Eurobank and Alpha Bank, Greece's four systemic banks. National Bank of Greece's card rates and price list (updated 27 October 2026, rates from 15 September 2025): every personal credit card it still issues, nine of them; the Mastercard, VISA, Gold Mastercard and Platinum Mastercard, which it no longer issues, aren't written. Each card's purchase and cash rates are stated before the 0.60% levy of Law 128/75 and written with it added, as Alpha Bank's is (Dual Mastercard Credit 19.89% and 20.89%, Silver 19.89% and 20.89%, Gold 19.39% and 20.39%, Black 16.39% and 20.39%, Skroutz Plus Mastercard 19.89% and 20.89%, ΙΑΣΩ My Club Card VISA and Iaso Mastercard 18.58% and 19.58%, the Toyota VISA and Mastercard 17.61% and 19.11%); the 9.90% purchase rate for the first 6 months, which the table marks on the Dual, Silver, Gold, Black and both Toyota cards, is written as an introductory rate of 10.50% with the levy. The yearly fee of the main card (Dual 6 euros, Silver 12, Gold 60, Black 120, Skroutz Plus 12, ΙΑΣΩ and Iaso 33, the Toyota cards nothing) is waived for the first year where the table marks it, and the Gold's for purchases above 7,000 euros a year, the Black's above 12,000. A payment in another currency costs 2% (the floor of 1 euro not modelled), the Black nothing. The over-limit charge, 5% of the excess with a floor of 5 euros, sits in one cell spanning the table's rows and is read as applying to every card. Cash at the bank's own and other euro-area machines is free (outside the euro area 3 euros, not modelled as a cash fee); the Value Plus package's lower prices aren't written. Eurobank's card pages answered 403 Access Denied (Akamai) and Piraeus Bank's an Incapsula check (neither circumvented); Alpha Bank's credit-card list page also answered 403 Access Denied on 2026-10-30, so its card already in the file wasn't re-read. The minimum payment: Alpha Bank's Bonus Visa page, 2% of the card's balance each month (no floor stated); National Bank of Greece's price list, a monthly instalment of at least 2% of principal and interest together, plus charges, at least 10 euros, for every personal card (3% for its private label and MyCash cards, none of which is written here), written as 2% with a 10-euro floor; the charges added on top aren't modelled.
